title: Identity-vetting statement value — shared definition
description: The `credentialSubject.object.value` of a Vetting Statement: a DTG Verifiable Statement Credential (`StatementCredential`) under the predicate `https://registry.trustoverip.org/dtg/vsc/vetted/1`, issued by a vetter's member DID about an applicant's DID, attesting that the vetter checked the applicant's claimed identity in a vetting session. The member set and the enumerated values are exactly those of the predicate's object schema in the DTG VSC predicate registry (`https://registry.trustoverip.org/dtg/vsc/vetted/1/vetting.schema.json`); where this definition is narrower — it requires the three vetter-only members `identityCommitment`, `cardDigestMultibase` and `declaredRelationship`, which a vetter's statement always carries and the registry makes all-or-nothing because a statement the community issues for itself carries none of them, and claim and document types use the vetting vocabularies — every value it accepts is also valid under the registry schema. There is no `type` member: the statement's `predicate` carries its meaning. A community names that predicate in its manifest as `vetting.statementType`. The credential envelope — `issuer`, `issuerScope`, validity, `taskContext`, `taskDigestMultibase`, proof — belongs to DTG credentials; only the object value is defined here. It records what the vetter did and relied on, never what they saw: no document number, no image, no claimed name. Not itself a Trust Task specification (the `_shared` folder is skipped by the registry build and the codegen).

community.description: The one community this statement is for — the vetting session's `domain`. A statement counts for that community only; another community does not count it without an explicit recognition policy of its own.

documentClasses.description: The documentation the vetter relied on, from their own accepted list. Empty, or absent, where they relied on none — expected with `priorAcquaintance`. `none` is never listed: 'no document' is the empty list. Never a document number, image or portrait.

claimsVerified.description: The claim types on the card the vetter marked as verified. Types only — never values.

livenessConfirmed.description: True only where the vetter and the applicant read each other the same session match code, establishing that the person the vetter checked controls `credentialSubject.id` in this session.

identityCommitment.description: The card's `identityCommitment`, copied verbatim: a salted commitment to the identity claims the applicant presented, multibase base58btc. Equal across every statement of one application; the salt that opens it is never in the statement.

cardDigestMultibase.description: Digest over the RFC 8785 canonicalization of the Vetting Card exactly as the vetter received it, `proof` included, multibase base58btc. Lets the applicant confirm the statement is about the card they sent, and lets a dispute establish which card a statement rests on, without the community ever holding the card.

declaredRelationship.description: The vetter's own declaration of how they relate to the applicant.

attestationTextDigest.description: RECOMMENDED. Digest over the UTF-8 bytes of the attestation text the vetter was shown and signed, as published under the community's governance framework, multibase base58btc — so which wording a vetter agreed to is provable after that wording changes. Absent where the community shows no attestation text.
